//go:build integration

package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/usecase"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/infrastructure/adapters"
	runtimehttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/transport/http"
)

type t08WorkspaceFixture struct {
	Schema             string              `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string              `json:"student_id"`
	TaskInstanceID     string              `json:"task_instance_id"`
	TaskRevisionID     string              `json:"task_revision_id"`
	TaskRevisionDigest string              `json:"task_revision_digest"`
	StepID             string              `json:"step_id"`
	Locale             string              `json:"locale"`
	Target             domain.Target       `json:"target"`
	Title              string              `json:"title"`
	Objective          string              `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables       []string            `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance         []domain.Acceptance `json:"acceptance"`
}

// This fixture persists a synthetic frozen instance; it does not invoke Start,
// Sandbox, Student reservation, Teacher, validators or official outcomes. The
// Planner route and subsequent commands use actual HTTP adapters and owners.
func TestT08WorkspaceHTTPProvider(t *testing.T) {
	plannerURL, token := os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_URL"), os.Getenv("T08_PLANNER_TOKEN")
	fixtureFile := os.Getenv("T08_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_FIXTURE_FILE")
	readyFile, stopFile := os.Getenv("T08_RUNTIME_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T08_RUNTIME_STOP_FILE")
	if plannerURL == "" || token == "" || fixtureFile == "" || readyFile == "" || stopFile == "" {
		t.Skip("owned T08 Runtime provider fixture is not configured")
	}
	var fixture t08WorkspaceFixture
	payload, err := os.ReadFile(fixtureFile)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &fixture); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if fixture.Schema != "t08-workspace-provider-fixture.v1" || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(fixture.StudentID) ||
		!domain.IsCanonicalUUID(fixture.TaskInstanceID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(fixture.TaskRevisionID) || !domain.IsCanonicalUUID(fixture.StepID) ||
		!validDigest(fixture.TaskRevisionDigest) || fixture.Locale == "" || fixture.Title == "" || fixture.Objective == "" {
		t.Fatal("invalid owned T08 frozen-instance fixture")
	}
	repository, db := openTestRepository(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	instance := fixtureInstance()
	instance.ID, instance.StudentID, instance.TaskRevisionID = fixture.TaskInstanceID, fixture.StudentID, fixture.TaskRevisionID
	instance.TaskRevisionDigest, instance.Locale = fixture.TaskRevisionDigest, fixture.Locale
	instance.LearningActionID = testUUID(0x8008) // Synthetic actor context; no Student reservation is claimed.
	instance.Steps[0].ID, instance.Steps[0].Title, instance.Steps[0].Objective = fixture.StepID, fixture.Title, fixture.Objective
	instance.Steps[0].Deliverables, instance.Steps[0].Acceptance = fixture.Deliverables, fixture.Acceptance
	instance.Steps[0].Targets, instance.Steps[0].Status = []domain.Target{fixture.Target}, "LEARNING_REQUIRED"
	instance.CurrentStep = &instance.Steps[0]
	instance.RevisionSummary.RevisionID, instance.RevisionSummary.Digest = instance.TaskRevisionID, instance.TaskRevisionDigest
	instance.RevisionSummary.Title, instance.RevisionSummary.Type = "T08 synthetic frozen practice", "BUILD"
	instance.RevisionSummary.Surface, instance.RevisionSummary.FamilyKey = "practice", "t08-practice"
	instance.RevisionSummary.VariantKey = "t08-variant"
	instance.RevisionSummary.RevisionNumber, instance.RevisionSummary.PublishedAt = 1, time.Now().UTC()
	instance.RevisionEnvelope.Revision.ID, instance.RevisionEnvelope.RevisionDigest = instance.TaskRevisionID, instance.TaskRevisionDigest
	// A syntactically valid unprovisioned reference is required by the public DTO;
	// Available=false truthfully declares that no Sandbox workspace exists here.
	instance.WorkspaceBinding = domain.WorkspaceBinding{Schema: "practice-workspace-binding.v2", SandboxID: testUUID(0x8009), Available: false}
	planner := adapters.NewLearningPlannerHTTPClient(plannerURL, token, &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second})
	request, err := domain.BuildLearningRouteRequest(instance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	instance.LearningRoute, err = planner.ResolveRoute(ctx, ports.ResolveLearningRoute{Request: encoded})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: actual Planner route resolution: %v", err)
	}
	// Preserve the exact ARRAY returned by the production adapter. Wrapping it
	// in {steps: ...} would mask an incompatible materialization consumer.
	if len(instance.LearningRoute.Steps) == 0 || instance.LearningRoute.Steps[0] != '[' {
		t.Fatal("actual Planner route must expose the frozen steps array")
	}
	instance, _, err = repository.CreateOrLoadStart(ctx, instance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	instance.Status = domain.TaskInstanceInProgress
	instance, err = repository.SaveInstance(ctx, instance)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err := NewRepository(db).GetInstance(ctx, fixture.StudentID, fixture.TaskInstanceID)
	if err != nil || loaded.LearningRoute.ID != instance.LearningRoute.ID || loaded.LearningRoute.RouteDigest != instance.LearningRoute.RouteDigest ||
		!jsonEqual(loaded.LearningRoute.Steps, instance.LearningRoute.Steps) {
		t.Fatalf("SETUP: frozen real Planner route persistence: %v", err)
	}
	runtime := &usecase.Runtime{Repository: NewRepository(db), Planner: planner}
	server := httptest.NewServer((&runtimehttp.Server{Runtime: runtime}).Handler())
	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
	var databaseSchema string
	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT current_schema()`).Scan(&databaseSchema); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ready, err := json.Marshal(map[string]string{
		"base_url": server.URL, "database_schema": databaseSchema, "student_id": instance.StudentID, "instance_id": instance.ID,
		"revision_id": instance.TaskRevisionID, "step_id": fixture.StepID, "route_id": instance.LearningRoute.ID,
		"classification": "actual Runtime HTTP+PG and actual Planner HTTP route; synthetic frozen instance/actor; no Start/Sandbox/Teacher/validator outcomes",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(readyFile, ready, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Log("T08 owned actual Runtime provider ready; actual frozen Planner steps array retained")
	t08WaitRuntimeStop(t, stopFile)
	final, err := NewRepository(db).GetInstance(ctx, fixture.StudentID, fixture.TaskInstanceID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var commandReceipts int
	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM practice_command_receipts WHERE task_instance_id=$1`, instance.ID).Scan(&commandReceipts); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	decision := "NONE"
	if final.Steps[0].ReadinessReceipt != nil {
		decision = final.Steps[0].ReadinessReceipt.Decision
	}
	t.Logf("owned actual Runtime SQL readback: status=%s stepStatus=%s readinessDecision=%s version=%d commandReceipts=%d", final.Status, final.Steps[0].Status, decision, final.Version, commandReceipts)
}

func t08WaitRuntimeStop(t *testing.T, stopFile string) {
	t.Helper()
	timer := time.NewTimer(15 * time.Minute)
	defer timer.Stop()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(200 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		if _, err := os.Stat(stopFile); err == nil {
			return
		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		select {
		case <-timer.C:
			t.Fatal("T08 Runtime provider timed out awaiting root stop file")
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
